headline: The young Kenyan engineer who thinks robots belong in every classroom

story_facts.headline: The young Kenyan engineer who thinks robots belong in every classroom
story_facts.plain_language_summary: During her mentoring of young people in STEM, she met deaf students struggling through STEM classes because qualified sign language interpreters were scarce. It struck her as an engineering problem as much as an educational one.
